long: Edit <image1> into a new photorealistic horizontal film still. Keep this exact man from <image1> unchanged: same face, same messy curly silver-white hair, same clean-shaven round face, same thick black square-rimmed glasses, same mustard-yellow wool cardigan, same blue checked shirt, same pencil behind his right ear. Replace the plain background with a small modern home kitchen with pale green cabinets on the back wall and a window on the right letting in soft morning daylight. He stands in the center of the frame behind a table, shown once, from the waist up, with clear space above his head. A plain wooden table runs across the bottom of the frame. A white ceramic plate holding one slice of golden buttered toast, butter side up, sits on the table in the left third of the frame. He faces the lens with his hands resting on the table and his chin lifted. Natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, soft morning daylight from the right. No text, logos or watermarks.
